name: How do I know if my grout still has sealer on it?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my grout still has sealer on it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The quickest check is the **water-drop test**. Put a few drops of water on a clean, dry grout line and watch for 1 to 2 minutes; if the water beads up, the sealer is still working, but if the grout darkens or absorbs water quickly, it is time to reseal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use the water-drop test on clean, dry grout. Beading means the sealer is holding; fast absorption means it needs resealing.
